keyEvents.text: Raphael Onyedika (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Freiburg 0. Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ritsu Doan.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Freiburg 1. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jordy Makengo.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 2, Freiburg 1. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Robin Koch following a corner.
Mio Backhaus (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Oscar Højlund replaces Noël Aséko.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 2, Freiburg 2. Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Derry Scherhant with a cross.
Oscar Højlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Nnamdi Collins replaces Elias Baum.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Ansgar Knauff replaces Ritsu Doan.
